page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.s3.large is an x86_64 architecture server instance belonging to the ecs.s3 server family. It is configured with 4 dedicated vCPUs mapped to 4 physical cores, operating with a single thread per core. The instance is equipped with 8.0 GB of system memory, yielding a memory-to-core ratio of 2.0 GB per physical core. It runs on the KVM hypervisor.

This server type does not bundle any local NVMe or SSD storage, meaning all storage requirements must be met via external block storage volumes. It features zero GPU accelerators, making it unsuitable for hardware-accelerated graphics or deep learning workloads. Additionally, the instance does not include complimentary public IPv4 addresses.

With a 1:2 vCPU-to-RAM ratio, the ecs.s3.large is structured for compute-focused workloads that do not demand large memory footprints. The dedicated CPU allocation ensures consistent processing performance without resource contention. This hardware profile is appropriate for lightweight web serving, batch processing, and basic computational tasks where dedicated CPU execution is required but memory demands remain low.
